title: Starwatch
description: data of: starwatch.py STAR [--plan | --measure SESSION | --history] --json. A watched star (Tabby's star) imaged through the patrol and measured against the stars round it: the night's brightness on Gaia's G scale beside its usual level, and whether it is dipping. With --plan, the patrol's plan only; with --history, every night measured. Nothing is reported for you.

name.description: The name mount.py and shoot.py know it by.

camera.description: The camera profile; a kept night without one is the 183C's.

filter.description: The filter; null for an unfiltered camera. Only nights of the same camera and filter share a baseline.

band.description: The instrumental band in words, e.g. L (Optolong), 183M.

transit_reach.description: With --transit-reach: whether the newest series' nights could show the proposed 0.012 mag transit at three sigma; can_see is null until three nights.

colour.description: With --colour: B's change against its usual level less R's; positive is redder. change is null until both have a baseline.

uncertainty.description: The night's error and the night-to-night spread together, in magnitudes.

baseline.description: The median of the other nights, once there are BASELINE_NIGHTS.

dimmer.description: Magnitudes fainter than the baseline (negative: brighter).
